info.title: query_inventory
info.description: Natural-language questions over the Landfall inventory (Azure SQL). Returns rows and the SELECT that produced them.

post.summary: Answer a count/sizing/aggregation question about the client inventory
post.description: Send a plain-English question. The service writes one read-only T-SQL SELECT against the servers/applications/dependencies/storage tables, runs it, and returns the rows plus the SQL used. Read-only; results are capped at 200 rows.

question.description: e.g. 'how many prod Windows Server 2012 VMs and their total vCPU?'

rows.description: each row is an array of cell values in column order

truncated.description: true if more than 200 rows matched

400.description: The generated query was not a safe read-only SELECT
